title: Physics that keeps only the outer reality leaves out free will

statements.text: Admitting free will carries interiority, selfhood, qualia, purpose and meaning into physics. Physics focused only on the outer symbolic reality assumes consciousness emerges from inert matter, though no plausible account of how has been given.

sources.locator: section 'The Scientific Study of Inner Reality'
sources.quote: they assume that consciousness spontaneously emerges only from complex organizations of inert matter devoid of any interiority
